extraction_limitations: Atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; no human verification was performed.
The extraction focuses on the paper's own benchmark/training claims and does not re-atomize underlying studies shown as P-Bench examples.
Table 1 is represented for the headline proprietary comparator, DeepSeek V4 Pro Strict metrics, and both Fisher-R1 variants rather than every cell for every baseline.
The embedding-similarity contamination check is preserved as reported; broader pretraining-data contamination was not independently audited.
No dedicated funding or conflict-of-interest statement was identified in the retrieved PDF text.
